entities.summary: The Poultry Club of Great Britain is a registered charity founded in 1877. Its stated purpose is to "safeguard the interests of all pure and traditional breeds of poultry including chickens, bantams, ducks, geese and turkeys". Poultry Club of Great Britain is a charitable organization in Europe, established in 1877. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
